title: IterationLoop
description: The review/coverage iteration loop on a feature (COMP-DOGFOOD-REVIEW-LOOP-1, row E of COMP-DOGFOOD-1). Routes: POST /api/vision/items/:id/lifecycle/iteration/{start,report,abort} (server/vision-routes.js), MCP tools start_iteration_loop, report_iteration_result, abort_iteration_loop. The owner rules are smart-memory-ops claude/rules/review-loop.md:6 (max 2 review rounds, 1 for BOUNDED, a 3rd only for a security HIGH) and :8 (same class in round 2, or a 3rd round asked for, means no one more round: write an alternatives note and offer REDESIGN). Every refusal is a coded 4xx `{error, code}` that writes nothing. Codes: ROUND_CAP_EXCEEDED (400), FINDING_INVALID (400), FINDING_CLASS_REQUIRED (400), NEEDS_REDESIGN (409), REDESIGN_NOTE_REQUIRED (400).

tier.description: Sets the review cap. bounded 1, standard 2, security 2 (a security loop may take a 3rd round, see loopState.security_extension). Other loop types ignore it.

maxIterations.description: A review loop above its tier's cap is refused ROUND_CAP_EXCEEDED.

finding.description: One review finding. A HIGH or MEDIUM names its class: the kind of defect, so that the same kind coming back in the next round is detectable. Free text, compared trimmed and case-insensitive.

reportResult.description: One iteration result. For a review loop `findings` are validated as `finding`; for a coverage loop only `passing` is read.

redesign_note.description: Repo-relative path (to the Compose project root) of the alternatives note. Required, and must exist, when the loop has needs_redesign (REDESIGN_NOTE_REQUIRED).

classes.description: Distinct classes of this round's HIGH and MEDIUM findings, trimmed and lower-cased.

high_classes.description: The subset of `classes` carried by a HIGH.

loopState.description: lifecycle.iterationState. The review-only fields (tier, cap, capped_from, rounds, needs_redesign, security_extension) are absent on a coverage loop.

outcome.description: same_class leaves status `running` (needs_redesign true): the loop closes only through abort with a redesign_note.

capped_from.description: The settings (or default) value that was lowered to the cap; null when nothing was lowered.

security_extension.description: True once a security loop was granted its 3rd round because round 2 carried a HIGH of a new class.
